Choose compatible materials

Stitch both squares with enough fabric margin around them. The center designs can differ on each face, but the assembly perimeter must contain exactly the same number of backstitches.

Prepare the finish before stitching

To join, keep the right sides facing outward and sew through the backstitch bars of both squares. Start at a corner of one piece and the midpoint of a side on the other; that offset creates the characteristic shape.

Avoid problems in real use

Add stuffing before the seam is fully closed. Insert small amounts and distribute them toward the points so the center does not become hard while the corners stay empty.

Finish it securely

An optional central button is attached through both faces and gently tightened to create the dimple. Do not pull so hard that the seam distorts or the fabric tears.
